component.name: PhotoLife
component.summary: Catalogue nature photos against a taxonomic tree

description.p: PhotoLife builds a catalogue alongside your nature photo library and hangs each photo on the tree of life. It reads reference taxonomies and regional species lists from iNaturalist and from checklist CSVs, matches your photos to taxa by folder and file name, and shows coverage — which species you have photographed and which branches are still bare.
First packaged build: scan, taxonomy, matching, coverage, review.
